create_strategy_data: create a hypothesis search strategy for generating data matching a Polars data type
create_strategy_integers: create a hypothesis search strategy for generating signed or unsigned integers of a given bit width
create_strategy_lists: create a hypothesis search strategy for generating lists of a given inner data type
create_strategy_structs: create a hypothesis search strategy for generating dictionaries with named struct fields
create_strategy_datetimes: create a hypothesis search strategy for generating datetime objects with a given time unit and timezone
